text:
maria: Quick proposal — add an ephemeral pin mode and a couple of short deploy-bot aliases for fast canaries. Goal: quick smoke + auto-unpin after X minutes, with a guard flag to prevent accidental full rollouts. Drafting templates now.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: new feature request recorded: ephemeral_pin + guard_mode. PR template added to issue #452.

sam: Nice. Two quick q's: 1) if ephemeral pin expires mid-rollback, who owns the rollback? 2) perms for who can unpin?

li: +1. For (1) suggest "lock-on-failure" behavior: if deploy fails during ephemeral pin, bot holds the pin until a human acknowledges. For (2) add a pin.owner and pin.team ACL (ops or owner). Also proposing a shortnotes auto-gen from changelog entries (summary + impact).

maria: Example CLI shorthand I'm thinking of:
```
/deploy canary --service=api --version=2026-03-20 --pin=ephemeral:30m --guard=ephemeral-mode --notes=auto
```
That should attach a small release note, run smoke checks, and unpin after 30m unless someone extends.

ops-bot: ops-bot: question — should unpin be limited to the pin owner or ops-role? current policy: pin.delete requires ops-team. We can add an override flag `--owner-unpin`.

natalie: Add a quick `--preflight=smoke,database` toggle that runs our standard health checks and returns a single pass/fail with links. If fail, bot posts diagnostics and keeps pin.

ash: I'll prototype the UX for the alias `/deploy quickpin` and a `rollforward` shortcut that advances rollout by percentage instead of immediate rollback. Template for release notes I recommend: 1) one-line summary, 2) user-visible impact, 3) rollback steps (one-liners). Keeps CTAs short.

maria: Can we also have the bot generate a perf dashboard link in the thread when the canary goes live? e.g., attach: https://dashboards/redwood/deploys/<deploy-id> and a condensed token-cost estimate.

sam: Another thought: `--guard=ephemeral-mode` should implicitly set `no-autopromote` so the canary never auto-promotes without explicit `promote` command. Add `--promote` as an explicit alias.

li: I'll put together a short RFC and a prototype in deploy-bot repo. Plan: draft RFC today, prototype by Thu, demo in next week's deploy sync.

maria: Thanks — I'm going to PR the templates to ops-templates repo tonight. Can someone add a tiny acceptance test for "ephemeral pin expires but retains lock-on-failure if preflight failed"?

ash: On it. I'll add a unit test and a smoke test harness entry.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: prototype branch `ephemeral-pin-guard` pushed to staging, bot commands wired to staging webhook. Use `/deploy --staging` to exercise.

maria: Perfect. Please drop any follow-ups here. If no objections, I'll tag this RFC WIP for review. :thumbsup:
